retrieval_notes.manual_mode: Manually invoked GitHub Actions job reruns via connected GitHub Actions-write API, not a new workflow_dispatch event. No authenticated browser session available. Fixed workflow_dispatch enabled on dedicated branch.
retrieval_notes.json_recovery: Exact census object recovered from completed job log. Script writes artifact file and prints the same object. Complete 200-row retention proved in corrected rerun.
retrieval_notes.zip_download: Artifact downloaded by GitHub connector as reusable file reference; attempts to save reusable URL locally returned HTTP403. ZIP digest is provider-reported, not independently rehashed locally.
retrieval_notes.forward_scope: Only logs and health receipt inspected; underlying current snapshot retained in GitHub artifact, not downloaded/opened locally.
